channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Bottled by Bears
item.description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

item.title: Car Flipper
item.description: A first person car flipping game. Find cheap used cars on your phone, on the side of the road or at storage auctions, and inspect them yourself. Fix what a buyer will notice, then sell them on, rent them out or race them for pink slips. Play solo or with up to three friends online.

item.title: CelSector
item.description: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.

item.title: Company of Heroes
item.description: Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines RTS by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. Please visit the "Company of Heroes - Legacy Edition" page for additional user reviews.

item.title: Engagement
item.description: Command a capital ship alone or up to 4 players co-op and hold the Belt of Ashes against the Hollow and more until relief arrives. Every upgrade is a turret bolted to a hardpoint you can see, your escorts you recruit keep their names and kills, and every fight has variety to make it new.

item.title: Evidence Vault
item.description: Your first night shift in a police evidence archive nobody has filed in years. Pick up loose papers, photos and tapes, uncover hidden case numbers with the right tool, then press, stamp, box and shelve each case. No clock, no quota, no way to fail.

item.title: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
item.description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

item.title: Handmancers
item.description: Handmancers is a Rock, Paper, Scissors Roguelite deckbuilder with a first-person twist where clear tactical choices meet deck-building depth. Craft your deck, enhance your cards, equip tricky artifacts and face powerful enemies in strategic fights

item.title: Hazard Levels
item.description: Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

item.title: Main Sequence
item.description: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

item.title: On The Train
item.description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.

item.title: One More Lawn
item.description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

item.title: Paystreak
item.description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.

item.title: Scawy Game
item.description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

item.title: Shelf-Made Tycoon
item.description: A cozy tycoon game about growing a tiny warehouse into a logistics empire. Land bigger deals until trucks, trains and ships bring work to your door. When money gets tight, a crime syndicate pays big for a few unmarked crates. Just hope the driver isn't an undercover cop.

item.title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
item.description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

item.title: Slay the Spire 2
item.description: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

item.title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
item.description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

item.title: The Devil's Due
item.description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

item.title: The Universim
item.description: Guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the Space Age in a city-building god game. Manage resources, research technology, survive natural disasters and alien threats, use godly powers to protect or punish your creations, and colonize distant planets.

item.title: Unfair Flips
item.description: A non-idle clicker game about flipping a coin that hates you. Starting with just a 20% chance of getting heads, can you get ten heads in a row?

item.title: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
item.description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

item.title: Aviassembly
item.description: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

item.title: Love in Summer
item.description: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

item.title: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
item.description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

item.title: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
item.description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.

item.title: Apotheosis Engine
item.description: Lost in the void, a space probe awakens to a mind it was never designed to possess. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game about exploring an alien operating system and growing from a simple probe into a digital deity.

item.title: Armory Keeper
item.description: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Sort over 3,000 weapons based on real-world firearms, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment into their proper places. Unlock abilities to work faster, or take a break at the shooting range!

item.title: Bright Memory: Infinite
item.description: Bright Memory: Infinite is an all-new lightning-fast fusion of the FPS and action genres, created by FYQD-Studio. Combine a wide variety of skills and abilities to unleash dazzling combo attacks.

item.title: Farm & Feast
item.description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

item.title: Gas N Cars
item.description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

item.title: Hope in the City
item.description: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

item.title: Imperial Grace
item.description: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

item.title: JOHN GLEEP
item.description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

item.title: MONOMOON
item.description: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

item.title: MycoRelic
item.description: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on islands inhabited by tribal mushroom robots. Loot derelict foundries to upgrade your robotic body. Explore ancient temples to infuse your fungus with forgotten elemental powers.

item.title: Rejected Draft
item.description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

item.title: The Last Flame
item.description: Recruit a party of unique heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create thousands of synergetic builds! The Last Flame is an endless roguelike auto-battler in which you guide a righteous party of heroes through many challenges.

item.title: Thronefall - Craaghelm
item.description: The Craaghelm DLC features a wealth of additional content for Thronefall, including new maps, weapons, perks, mutators, heroes, and units.

item.title: Void Reaver
item.description: Organize. Optimize. Obliterate. Void Reaver is a sci-fi bullet heaven where your backpack is your firepower. Grid-manage 300+ weapons and artifacts into explosive synergies, unlock specialized skill trees, and blast through alien hordes to a high-octane electronic soundtrack.
